Hi, this ticket needs a bit more information before we can start the checks.

Here is what to add:

### 1. Acceptance criteria
We could not find acceptance criteria.

You can copy this and adjust it to your case. Either format works. A short list under an "Acceptance criteria" heading, one result per line:

## Acceptance criteria
- The last cost is 0 after a movement with cost 0

Or Given / When / Then, each at the start of its line:

Given a product with last cost = 50
When I save a movement with cost = 0
Then the last cost is 0

Italian works too: "Criteri di accettazione", or Dato / Quando / Allora.

### 2. Steps to reproduce
There is no Steps to reproduce section (or user story).

A short numbered list is enough. You can adapt this:

## Steps to reproduce
1. Open the product
2. Save a movement with cost = 0
3. Check the last cost

### 3. Expected and actual result
Expected and Actual are not both filled in.

Please add both sections, for example:

## Expected
The last cost is 0

## Actual
The last cost is still 50

### 4. Summary
There is no Summary or Context section.

A couple of sentences is enough, for example:

## Summary
When cost is 0, last cost is not updated. The previous value is kept.

### 5. Title prefix
The title does not start with [FE], [BE] or [FS].

Please start the title with [BE] (backend), [FE] (frontend) or [FS] (both).
Example: [BE] last cost stays 50 when the movement cost is 0

### 6. Environment
There is no Environment section with Env: …

Please add which environment you used (prod, staging or local):

## Environment
Env: local

The full Bug template is in the warehouse-backend repository (.gitlab/issue_templates/Bug.md). In GitLab, pick "Bug" from the template menu when you open a new issue.
